Wikipedia already states that Archduke Leopold Salvator’s mother is Princess Maria Immaculata of Bourbon-Two Sicilies, who is therefore Archduchess Dolores’s paternal grandmother. The planner instead jumped a generation up to Karl Salvator’s mother (Princess Maria Antonia of the Two Sicilies), which would be Dolores’s paternal great-grandmother, leading the process toward an incorrect answer.
